questions.question: Which agent actions require a distinct runtime identity, and at what granularity should instances, sessions, and agent classes be distinguished?
How should authority attenuate across multi-agent delegation without breaking legitimate workflows?
questions.evidence_needed: Deployment studies with measured task success and unauthorized-action rates

questions.question: Which credential lifetimes, rotation rules, and revocation mechanisms work at production agent speed and scale?
What evidence should connect an agent action to a principal while preserving privacy and lawful anonymity?
questions.evidence_needed: Legal analysis, civil-society positions, privacy engineering, and incident investigations

questions.question: How should legal responsibility be allocated when developer, deployer, user, platform, and tool provider share control?
questions.evidence_needed: Multi-jurisdiction legal research and adjudicated or investigated cases

questions.question: How well do synthetic prompt-injection and vulnerability benchmarks predict production incidents?
When does human approval improve control, and when does it create consent fatigue or ceremonial oversight?
questions.evidence_needed: Controlled user research and operational audit data

questions.question: Can automated monitors reliably oversee agents that act faster or at greater volume than human reviewers?
questions.evidence_needed: Independent evaluations, failure analyses, privacy and cost measurements

questions.question: Who owns agent identity governance across CISO, CIO, CTO, GC, CFO, CEO, and board roles?
questions.evidence_needed: Role-specific interviews and documented decision-rights models

questions.question: How do requirements and implementations differ across industries and regulatory regions?
questions.evidence_needed: Region- and sector-specific evidence with explicit denominators
